html:
Grace Kelly was an American film star who married Prince Rainier III of Monaco in April 1956 and became Princess Grace.

She had won an Oscar and starred in films by Alfred Hitchcock such as Rear Window and To Catch a Thief, shot on the Riviera. She gave up acting for the marriage, which was watched by millions on television.

The wedding brought world attention and tourists to Monaco, and the birth of their children secured the Grimaldi line. Under a 1918 treaty Monaco would have passed to France if the dynasty died out. Princess Grace died in 1982 after a car crash on a mountain road above Monaco. Her son Albert II rules today.
sum: Grace Kelly was an American film star who married Prince Rainier III of Monaco in April 1956 and became Princess Grace.
